title: Screen and stability results summary
description: Results document of the preprint. Two sections, either or both present. 'regimes' (the parameter screen): per regime, the Monte Carlo propagation of the priors through each link of the chain (anchor, sequester, nucleate), quantiles of every propagated quantity, Sobol first- and total-order indices with confidence intervals, optional dependent-input (Shapley) indices, the cos(theta) boundary mass (lane note N2) and the threshold evaluation (null until thresholds are frozen). 'stability' (C5, deterministic, decision D4): R-slurry Pourbaix domains on a (pH, E vs SHE) grid with phase identities and per-phase decomposition energies, for the bulk and the enriched state (G0 fix F2); R-cell a one-dimensional window vs Li+/Li with reduction and oxidation limits per phase, each limit carrying status ok or undetermined, and the oxidation-sink assumption. An undetermined limit is never a pass. Version history: v1 (P0-W4.1) screen only; v2 (P0-W4.2) adds 'stability', 'boundary_mass' (required in v2 screen regimes), dependence metadata, Shapley indices, 'required_precision' and 'extensions'. A v1 document remains valid under this schema. Schema v3 (P0-W4.3a) adds: the speciation link and its refused-draw counts; the Fig 5 barrier prefactor per regime; the Fig 7 water-stability lines of the Pourbaix regime; the cp3 decision records (C5 dose window with its falsifiability control, the R-cell scheme table and cutoff axis, per-termination verdicts, per-design-point and per-framing verdicts, the prior set and whether a verdict may be stated as a finding).

schema_version.description: '3' for documents written since P0-W4.3a (contract v3, cp3 rulings); '2' since P0-W4.2; '1' documents keep the v1 rules (no stability section, no boundary mass).

mock.description: True when the run used mock priors. A mock summary is never an input to the paper.

extensions.description: Lane-specific metadata that is not part of the shared contract (for example W5's provenance_pourbaix, resolved inputs and session id), keyed by lane id. Nothing in it is read by another lane.

claims.description: Link verdicts under the frozen thresholds (configs/preprint/thresholds.yaml), C1 to C5.

git_sha.description: HEAD of the repository when the run started.

git_dirty.description: True when the working tree had uncommitted changes at run time.

config_hash.description: sha256 of the canonical JSON of the run configuration (sorted keys, no whitespace).

prior_file.description: Repository-relative path of the prior file (screen documents).

prior_file_hash.description: sha256 of the raw bytes of the prior file.

contract_sha.description: Commit of the theory contract the physics was checked against, or null.

config_file.description: Repository-relative path of the run configuration file, when there is one.

config_file_hash.description: sha256 of the raw bytes of the run configuration file.

params_sha.description: Commit of lit/params.yaml the priors were read from, or null for mock priors.

thresholds_file.description: Repository-relative path of the thresholds file, or null before the freeze.

thresholds_hash.description: sha256 of the raw bytes of configs/preprint/thresholds.yaml, or null before the freeze.

thresholds_source_sha.description: Commit of theory/thresholds.md the thresholds were copied from.

schema_sha.description: Commit of this schema the document was written against.

provenance.description: Run provenance. A screen document also requires prior_file and prior_file_hash.

draws.description: Monte Carlo draws used for the quantiles.

seed.description: Root seed of the regime's random stream.

parameters.description: Names of the sampled inputs, in the order used by the Sobol design.

boundary_mass.description: cos(theta) boundary mass (lane note N2), keyed by link then by the quantity whose Young ratio was clipped (for example nucleate.cos_theta). Draws with a Young ratio above 1 are placed at theta = 0 (f = 0), below -1 at theta = 180 deg (f = 1); the counts make a verdict carried by clipped mass visible. Empty object per link when no Young ratio is evaluated.

dependence_check.description: Robustness of the ranking to the correlation assumption: the same indices recomputed under independence, with the rank agreement. Reported as a check in production; null when not run.

rank_agreement.description: Keyed by link then quantity: Kendall tau between the two rankings of the parameters, and whether the top-ranked parameter is the same.

convergence.description: Sobol convergence: the target CI half-width stated before sizing, the achieved maximum half-width, and the largest change of any index when the base sample size is doubled.

capped.description: True when the size the target needs exceeded the configured maximum and the run used the maximum instead; the shortfall shows in max_ci_half_width.

primary_state.description: Registered state that received the full sensitivity analysis.

unsampled.description: Inputs of the primary state without a samplable prior, with the table's reason.

states.description: Other registered states of the regime: propagated quantities, boundary mass and unsampled inputs (they enter the decision rule; worst_state and path_sum).

prior_set.description: Prior set of the run (schema v3, P0-W4.3a); a verdict under the ignorance set is never a finding.

refused.description: Draws refused by a model's validity range, keyed by link then model (speciation: the Davies activity model above I_val) (schema v3, P0-W4.3a).

sobol.description: Keyed by quantity name, then by parameter name.

threshold_evaluation.description: Per-link verdict-band evaluation against the frozen thresholds; null until they are frozen.

shapley.description: Shapley effects (valid for dependent inputs), keyed by quantity then parameter; each normalised by Var(Y), summing to one over the parameters.

sensitivity_scale.description: Per quantity, the scale its Sobol and Shapley indices are computed on: log10 for positive multiplicative quantities (saturation ratios, enrichment, concentrations, barriers, radii), linear otherwise. Quantities without an entry are reported (quantiles) without sensitivity indices.

shapley_design.description: Sample sizes of the Shapley estimation (n_var, n_outer, n_inner, costs estimated, evaluations, bootstrap).

n_valid.description: Draws inside the physical domain (finite results).

quantiles.description: Keyed by probability level written as a decimal string, e.g. "0.5".

n_finite.description: Draws with a finite Young ratio.

n_clipped_theta_0.description: Draws with ratio > 1, set to theta = 0 (complete spreading, f = 0).

n_clipped_theta_180.description: Draws with ratio < -1, set to theta = 180 deg (no wetting, f = 1).

dependence.description: How the inputs were sampled jointly.

rank_correlations.description: Stated Spearman rank correlations between pairs of parameters, with their source.

stability.description: C5 deterministic outputs (decision D4). Thermodynamic proxies only: which state is at equilibrium, not how fast anything corrodes, dissolves or decomposes.

reference_electrode.description: Potentials are in V vs SHE.

axes.description: Grid axes. Every grid in this regime is indexed [i][j] at E_V[i] and pH[j].

states.description: The bulk state (regime a_Ca, a_CO3) and the enriched state at the template (G0 fix F2).

conditions.description: Ion activities or concentrations, carbonate system and other inputs that define the state, each with its source.

phases.description: Identity of each stability domain; a domain's index in index_grid is its position here.

index_grid.description: Domain index at (E_V[i], pH[j]); -1 where no domain is defined.

decomposition_energy.description: Per phase (keyed by phase name, for example calcite, ACC, corundum): energy above the Pourbaix equilibrium on the grid.

formula.description: Formula of the phase (for the per non-O, non-H atom normalisation of the C5 edge).

kind.description: mixed: the domain combines components of different kinds.

reference_electrode.description: Potentials are in V vs Li+/Li.

convention.description: Sign convention of the limit potential (theory contract E_window).

sink_assumption.description: Where the cation goes on oxidation. The Li-open window of a Li-free phase is unbounded anodically (open question Q9), so every oxidation limit is conditional on this assumption.

kind.description: solid_salt: the cation leaves as the solid salt of the electrolyte anion; a pass under it is conditional on cp2 decision 5.

oxidation_by_scheme.description: Oxidation limit per registered gas reference scheme; the limit used is the lowest.

reduction_by_scheme.description: Reduction limit per registered gas reference scheme; the limit used is the highest.

schemes.description: Per gas-reference scheme: its role (governing: the all-experimental route; comparator: DFT schemes) and its measured benchmark error (schema v3, P0-W4.3a).

window_limit.description: One limit of a window. status ok carries a finite value; status undetermined carries a null value and a non-empty reason, and is never read as a pass.

required_precision.description: Required precision of each governing parameter (configs/preprint/precision_method.md), keyed by regime then parameter.

verdict.description: 'descriptor' for C2, a reported binding descriptor that never gates (cp2 F3).

gap.description: The parameter-table key or input that is missing; the test is then inconclusive.

P_good_range.description: Band mass over the simplex of termination weights (ignorance mixture, cp3 R8).

by_design.description: Per design point: the framing-combined verdict (cp3 R6), {verdict, governing_framing, by_framing}; for C2 the finding per framing.

design_dependent.description: True when the verdict differs between design points; the headline is then inconclusive.

finding_eligible.description: False when the verdict rests on an ignorance prior: never stated as a finding.

P_gamma_sl_gt_gamma_nl.description: P(gamma_sl > gamma_nl) at every registered state (block v2, C4 report_mass).

omega_controls.description: The Omega test's falsifiability controls (block v2): undersaturated must be falsified (dissolution), supersaturated feasible (stability).

by_design.description: Per design point: {verdict, governing_framing, by_framing} (cp3 R6).

truncation.description: Truncated priors (cp3 R8: gamma_sl0 >= 0): the removed mass, and with the untruncated sensitivity the verdicts that change.

barrier_prefactor.description: Fig 5: Delta_G*_hom / k_B T = B_kT / ln^2(Omega), with B_kT = 16 pi gamma_nl^3 V_m^2 / (3 N_A^2 (k_B T)^3) at the stated reference inputs (schema v3, P0-W4.3a).

water_lines.description: Fig 7: the water-stability lines on the pH axis of the regime, E_V[j] at pH[j] (V vs SHE) (schema v3, P0-W4.3a).

source.description: Where the standard potential comes from (a parameter-table key).

omega_point.description: Band mass of Omega_bulk >= 1 at one design point (cp3 R1); feasible means no dissolution.

dose_window.description: cp3 R1: the design points (Ca dose, C_T) where Omega_bulk >= 1 at the credible level (schema v3, P0-W4.3a).

cutoff_axis.description: cp3 R2: the verdict as a function of the cutoff (E_cell_max by cathode class, or E_cell_min) (schema v3, P0-W4.3a).

termination_verdicts.description: cp3 R8: the verdict of each populated termination; the mixture is the ignorance mixture over the weights (schema v3, P0-W4.3a).
